title: Vampire Vape Blood Sukka Longfill E-Liquid - 20ml
description: Experience Vampire Vape’s legendary Blood Sukka your way with our Longfill 20ml Flavour Concentrate. A thrilling flavour that tantalizes your taste buds with a fruity explosion. Each puff is a delightful journey through juicy cherries, ripe berries, and a blend of red fruits. Enhanced with sweet eucalyptus and aniseed for a satisfying throat hit, and finished with a frosty menthol touch, it adds a cool, invigorating twist to your vape. Perfect for those who love a complex, refreshing vaping experience. What are Longfills? Longfill e-liquids come with 20ml of flavour in a 60ml bottle, letting you add your preferred amount of nicotine shots and PG/VG. This means you have full control over the strength and ratio of your e-liquid. Unlike shortfills, which only go up to 3mg, Longfills can be mixed to 3mg, 6mg, 9mg, or 12mg strengths. How to Mix Your Longfill : Just open your bottle, add your nicotine shots, then top it up with PG/VG. Shake it well to mix, and it's ready to vape.
